From: Laura Chen  
Date: 04/14/2024 06:18 PM  
To: Michael Foster  
cc: David Kim  
Subject: Re: Evergreen Energy Partners - Revised Credit Worksheet  

Michael,

I spoke with the client, and it turns out they wanted the Local Currency ISDA form. I gave that revised draft to Jane for approval the same day I sent my note, but she’s been swamped and now the file is missing from her desk. I’ll follow up with her tomorrow to see what happened.



Michael Foster  
04/14/2024 05:53 PM  
To: David Kim  
cc: Laura Chen  
Subject: Evergreen Energy Partners - Revised Credit Worksheet  

David,  
Laura,

Attached is the revised credit worksheet for the counterparty referenced above. This update includes a $5 million parent company guaranty, raising the collateral threshold to $5 million and modifying other credit terms.

According to the Legal notes in our internal system, Laura was contacted by the client requesting a simpler agreement. She suggested using an Industrial Master agreement. If Legal approves, I’m fine with using the Industrial Master from a credit perspective.

Please prepare the revised credit worksheet as an amended Industrial Master.

Thank you,  
Michael
